title: Registry is extensible
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1 Subclaims.

statements.label: Registry is extensible
statements.requirement: Integrators SHALL be able to register more subclaims and their codecs, and override the defaults, at runtime, without forking the library.
